# dsh-superagent

> **Research prototype for reference only, not an official DeepSeek product.** This code grew out of our team's day-to-day development work, with much of the engineering done by coding agents. Treat it as research code, not production-ready software. It may still contain bugs, and its coding style and engineering practices may be inconsistent. Review and adapt it before using it in your own environment.
>
> We have adapted it for publication, so it is not identical to our internal version or the implementation described in *Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System*. Some designs discussed in the article are directions for future development and are not implemented in this prototype.

dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/). It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu. When someone allowed asks the agent for work, it opens a work item, works on it in its own agent session and directory, and answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request. A web panel shows what needs a person.

It is also a way of working with an agent: **take as little human attention as possible, and give as much value as possible.** An agent that can act for a whole team can also waste a whole team's attention, so it acts only when asked or when a rule the team wrote allows it, and speaks only when someone must act or can use a result. [docs/000-philosophy.md](docs/000-philosophy.md) explains the principle and what it asks of the operator.

## Setup

Setup has many steps, so an agent does it with you. Ask your coding agent:

> Read SETUP.md in this repository and set up dsh-superagent with me.

It asks one short question at a time, shows the full plan once, and then installs and configures everything. [SETUP.md](SETUP.md) is what it follows.

## Documentation

Read the numbered documents in order; each builds only on the ones before it.

- [000 Philosophy](docs/000-philosophy.md)
- [001 Domain model](docs/001-domain.md)
- [002 Authorization](docs/002-authorization.md)
- [003 Execution](docs/003-execution.md)
- [004 Prompts](docs/004-prompts.md)
- [005 Panel](docs/005-panel.md)
- [006 Deployment](docs/006-deployment.md): manual setup, configuration, upgrades and troubleshooting
- [007 Architecture](docs/007-architecture.md)
- [008 Cookbook](docs/008-cookbook.md): adding a Source

## Development

`pnpm check` runs the typecheck, the tests and the build.

# unslop

Created by Damir Sokolovsky ([@heydamir](https://x.com/heydamir)), who started the [Unslopping series](https://x.com/heydamir/status/2115063463063998736) on X.

![A vibecoded dashboard unslopping itself, frame by frame](skills/unslop/references/refs/story-dashboard-frames.webp)

unslop is a skill for Claude Code, Codex and Google Antigravity that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface with its own character. It finds the slop first, the purple gradients, glows, emoji labels, shouty copy and uneven spacing, then sets a direction from your product and fixes the screen pass by pass like a designer doing a redline review. It works in whatever your screen is built with, like Next.js, React, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind or plain HTML and CSS, on dashboards, apps and landing pages, and even on a live site when all you have is a link.

## Install

For Claude Code, install it as a plugin. Run this in a terminal to get it in every project:

```bash
claude plugin install unslop --marketplace heydamir/unslop
```

On an older Claude Code without `--marketplace`, the same in two steps:

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add heydamir/unslop
claude plugin install unslop@heydamir
```

To get it in a single project only, run the install from that project's root folder, the one you start Claude Code in, and add `--scope local`. To turn it on for everyone who works in the project, add `--scope project` instead and commit `.claude/settings.json`. Each teammate then runs this once in their own copy of the project:

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add heydamir/unslop
claude plugin install unslop@heydamir --scope project
```

Then start a new Claude Code session, or run `/reload-plugins` in one that is already open.

To update, run `claude plugin update unslop@heydamir`, or turn on auto-update for the heydamir marketplace under Marketplaces in `/plugin`.

If you copied unslop into `~/.claude/skills/` or a project's `.claude/skills/` before, delete that copy, or `/unslop` keeps running it instead of the plugin.

For Codex, ask it to install the skill straight from this repo.

```
$skill-installer install https://github.com/heydamir/unslop/tree/main/skills/unslop
```

Or copy it by hand into `~/.agents/skills/`, or into `.agents/skills/` inside a single project.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/heydamir/unslop
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && cp -r unslop/skills/unslop ~/.agents/skills/
```

For Google Antigravity, copy the skill into your skills folder.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/heydamir/unslop
mkdir -p ~/.gemini/config/skills && cp -r unslop/skills/unslop ~/.gemini/config/skills/
```

For a single project, copy it into `.agents/skills/` inside that project instead.

To snapshot a live site or create a story video, install Playwright and its Chromium browser from the project directory where you run the skill:

```bash
npm install -D playwright
npx playwright install chromium
```

Story videos also require ffmpeg installed and available on your PATH.

## Use

In Claude Code, type `/unslop` with what you want, or `/unslop:unslop` if another skill already has that name. In Codex, type `$unslop` the same way. Or just ask in your own words and the agent picks the skill up by itself.

```
/unslop this dashboard
/unslop the hero of https://example.com
/unslop my landing page and make the story video so I can post it
```

It audits the screen and proposes a direction before it edits anything, so you can steer it early. If the screen is already good, it tells you so and suggests a few small refinements instead of redesigning it.

## What it does

- **Audit.** Lists every sign of slop with where it lives.
- **Direction.** Character, world, the one or two moments that carry the color, and a signature detail, all taken from your product.
- **Passes.** Spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals and motion, in that order.
- **Visuals.** Shows your product instead of a glossy blob. When a hero needs a scene or an object, it can generate one through an image service like fal, Replicate, OpenAI images or Higgsfield. If none is connected, it offers to connect one as an MCP server, and it shows the prompt and asks before every paid generation. Dashboards and apps rarely need one.
- **Story video.** A square video under 10 seconds of your screen unslopping itself, ready to post. It needs Playwright and ffmpeg.

Try it on the two vibecoded screens in [examples](examples).

## Hire the unslopper

Would rather have a designer do it? Damir unslops one key screen in 3 days, built in your stack, at [heydamir.design/unslop](https://heydamir.design/unslop).

## License

Kiri: a tiny, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux

Docker Desktop is slow to start and heavy when idle. Kiri is a lightweight replacement written in Rust. It runs your Docker images and works with the docker CLI, Compose and buildx you already use.

Quickstart · Docs · Features · Download · Security

--- ## Before you begin Make sure you have one of: - macOS 14 or later, on Apple silicon or Intel - Windows 10 or 11 with WSL 2, on x86-64 or Arm - Linux (Ubuntu, Fedora and others) ## Step 1: Install and start Kiri macOS, with Homebrew: ```bash brew install --cask libracoder/kiri/kiri ``` Or download the installer for your system: | Platform | Get it | |----------|--------| | macOS 14+ (Apple silicon or Intel) | `.dmg` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/), or `brew install --cask libracoder/kiri/kiri` | | Windows 10 and 11 (x86-64 or Arm, through WSL 2) | `.msi` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/) | | Linux (Ubuntu, Fedora and others) | `.deb` or `.rpm` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/) | The first time you open Kiri, it sets up a `kiri` Docker context. Kiri updates itself, and checks each new release's signature first. Then run your first container: ```bash docker --context kiri run --rm alpine echo hello ``` --- ## Table of Contents - [Before you begin](#before-you-begin) - [Install and start Kiri](#step-1-install-and-start-kiri) - [Why Kiri?](#why-kiri) - [Quick Start](#quick-start) - [Features](#features) - [Docker commands](#docker-commands) - [Benchmarks](#benchmarks) - [Comparison](#comparison) - [How Kiri Works](#how-kiri-works) - [Documentation](#documentation) - [Roadmap](#roadmap) - [Community](#community) - [Security](#security) - [License](#license) --- ## Why Kiri? Kiri runs containers in one small Linux VM (or straight on the kernel on Linux) and speaks the Docker Engine API, so your tools just work. The name comes from the Igbo word *ntakịrị*, "small". - **Fast**: a container starts and exits in about 2.5 ms through the Docker API. ## Skills

- **socratic-tutor** — turns an LLM into a strict personal tutor that teaches a
  topic of your choice using the Socratic method: a diagnostic, a skill map with
  levels 0-5, one question at a time, spaced review, and a final assessment.

## How to use

With a coding agent that supports the common `SKILL.md` format, copy the skill
directory into your agent's skills folder, then ask the agent to use it
("teach me X").

With a plain chatbot, paste the body of the skill's `SKILL.md` into the chat
(or into a custom/system prompt), followed by what you want it to do.

## Contributing

These skills are exported from our internal repository, where we use them day to
day, and we hope it's interesting to share that experience more widely. Since
we're trying to share what _we've_ found to be useful, we're not looking for new
skills or for pull requests that change the text of existing ones. If you've
adapted a skill and it works better for you, that's great, but please keep your
own copy.

Issues are welcome if something doesn't work as described, though we may not be
able to act on all of them.

## Prior art

Teaching by asking questions is the
[Socratic method](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Socratic_method), which is
rather older than LLMs, and there are other tutoring prompts and skills built on
the same idea. Our skill was written internally and isn't knowingly derived from
any other implementation.

content.readme:
# ApkStart

[![CI](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/RoutineMiku/apkstart?include_prereleases&sort=semver)](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%2010%2F11%20x64-0078D6.svg)](#) **Windows 上的安卓应用运行器 —— 让安卓应用像 Windows 原生软件一样被安装和使用。** 注：本项目为早期版本，作者自娱自乐产物，所有修改都是作者下班和休息日在处理，开源免费，不插广告，暂时也不是很好用，没有找过营销号推广，无妄之灾。 - 🖱️ **双击 .apk 即安装**：注册 .apk 文件关联后，在资源管理器里双击 APK，自动解析 → 安装 → 生成桌面图标，全程无需打开任何模拟器界面。 - 🧩 **每个应用一个桌面图标**：图标从 APK 内部离线提取并转为多尺寸 ICO，双击桌面图标 = 直接启动该应用，与打开一个原生 Windows 软件的体验一致。 - 🪟 **应用就是一个窗口**：运行时以**带窗口**模式启动（无头模式下 Android 不出 VSYNC，应用进程活着但屏幕上是空的），ApkStart 把这块窗口改标题、换真实应用图标、按竖屏比例摆好位置，就是一个独立应用窗口；**全屏**铺满屏幕高度并居中，**窗口模式**可自由拖动缩放且按应用记忆尺寸。 - 🔍 **能被 Windows 搜到**：安装后同时创建桌面 + 开始菜单（`程序\ApkStart\`）快捷方式，按应用名在开始菜单搜索即可直达，任务栏按应用分组。 - 📁 **数据互通**：`%USERPROFILE%\ApkStartShared` ↔ 安卓内 `/sdcard/ApkStartShared` 持续双向同步，安卓应用存下的文件直接出现在本机。 - 🪶 **极致轻量**：壳层本身零第三方依赖（连 ZIP / PNG / ICO / AXML 解析都是手写的），运行时按需拉起，空闲自动回收；也可以完全复用你机器上已有的安卓运行时，额外占用为零。 ![主界面](docs/images/app.png) ``` ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 桌面图标（真实应用图标 .lnk） │ │ │ 双击 │ │ ▼ │ │ ApkStart.exe --launch <包名> │ │ │ 运行时未启动？→ 自动拉起（Android Emulator + API34）│ │ ▼ │ │ 按系统解析出的 LAUNCHER 入口启动（不是 APK 里的主 Activity）│ │ │ 存活观察 18 秒，闪退自动重试 / 重置数据 / 补权限 │ │ ▼ │ │ 模拟器窗口 = 应用窗口（改标题、换图标、竖屏比例、全屏居中） │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ## 下载即用（不想编译） 两个源内容一致，国内建议用 Gitee： - GitHub：[github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/releases](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/releases) - Gitee：[gitee.com/daily-miku/apkstart/releases](https://gitee.com/daily-miku/apkstart/releases)（国内直连快得多） 安装包（三种形态，内容与版本号完全一致）： | 形态 | 文件名 | 何时选它 | |---|---|---| | 商店版 | `ApkStart_<四段版本>_x64.msix` | 从 Microsoft Store 装。内置完整运行时，装完不联网；自更新交给商店 | | 完整便携版 | `ApkStart-v*-win64-full.zip`（约 830 MB，解压 ~1.3 GB） | **不想装、也不想等下载**：解压即用，运行时（模拟器 + 系统镜像）全在包里 | | 安装版 | `ApkStart-v*-Setup.exe`（约 1.3 GB） | 想要桌面/开始菜单快捷方式、卸载项 | | 轻量便携版 | `ApkStart-v*-win64-portable.zip`（96 MiB，解压 ~227 MB） | 只想先试试，首次启动再联网下载运行时 | > 所有形态的 `ApkStart.exe` 都写入了**品牌图标 + 版本资源**（FileDescription = `ApkStart 安卓应用运行器`， > CompanyName = `RoutineMiku`，版本与 `package.json` 同步），不再是 Electron 的默认图标和 `33.x` 版本号。 > 自己从源码打包时：`npm run pack`（轻量）/ `npm run pack:full`（完整）/ `npm run build:msix`（商店包）。 ### 画面铺满是怎么做到的 模拟器的**物理面板方向**（`hw.lcd.width/height`）就是画面的真实形状。面板方向和应用自己声明的 `screenOrientation` 不一致时，Android 只会给应用一个信箱式的中间窄条 —— 两侧补黑，换窗口大小、 改 `wm size`、改 letterbox 样式都填不满（这套组合逐项试过，见 `src/core/apk.js` 的注释）。 所以 ApkStart 在**安装 APK 时离线解析 `AndroidManifest.xml`**，统计出这个应用天然是横屏还是竖屏 （启动 Activity 加权；全 `sensor` / `fullSensor` 的会在首次运行后再问安卓要一次实际值），存进 `apps.json`，启动时按它选面板： - 红果短剧这类竖屏应用 → 竖屏面板 720×1280，正立、铺满、density 190（sw606dp）同时给出平板排版； - 墨读这类横屏应用 → 横屏面板 1280×720，正立、铺满。 只有「面板方向和应用方向不一致」的那一次才重启运行时（约 40 秒，标题栏会给出提示）， 之后同方向的应用都是秒进。标题栏的旋转按钮会把这个应用的方向**记住**（其它应用不受影响）， 设置 → 应用窗口 → 屏幕方向可以改成「强制横屏 / 强制竖屏」。 排版由「逻辑密度」决定：720 宽按 190dpi 算等于 **606dp**，正好越过 Android 的 600dp 平板断点， 红果短剧的双列剧集页、设置页分栏都只在这个密度下出现（镜像默认 320dpi 只有 360dp，是手机排版）。 这就是设置里的「平板排版」开关，默认打开；关掉会回到手机排版。 ### 在线更新（自动选较快的源） 设置 → **软件更新** → 「检查更新」，或托盘右键 → 「检查更新」。发现新版本后点「立即更新」即可。 - 安装版下载 `ApkStart-v*-Setup.exe` 静默安装； - 轻量版下载 `ApkStart-v*-win64-portable.zip`，解压后覆盖**程序目录**——运行时目录（`%APPDATA%\apkstart\runtime`）、已装应用与快照都不在程序目录里，所以更新不会丢东西； - 替换动作由一段独立 PowerShell 脚本完成（等主进程退出 → 覆盖 → 重新拉起），**不会出现「请手动关闭程序」的弹窗**，也不会在桌面上残留模拟器窗口。 更新链路不是死连 GitHub，而是**每次现测现选**： 1. 同时问 GitHub 与 Gitee 的最新版本，取版本号更高的那个（一个源超时/被墙不影响另一个）； 2. 把「源站直连 / Gitee 同名资产 / 镜像前缀」列成候选，每个地址真下 256KB 测速， 只算「收到首字节之后」的吞吐（握手时间不计入，否则高延迟大带宽的源会被误判成慢）； 3. 按实测速度排序，用最快的那条分块并行下载；失败自动换下一条。 设置里的「下载与更新源」可以强制只用某一边（企业网络只放行一个域名时用）， 也可以关掉公共加速镜像、或改用自建镜像前缀。Gitee 附件单文件上限 100MB， 便携包换用 7-Zip 的 deflate（`-mx=9`）压缩后是 **95.0MB**，所以 Gitee 上也是 一个能直接双击解压的整包（以前要切成 `.part1/.part2` 手工拼接，那版已经废弃）。 两个源的同名包体积并不完全一样，客户端按测速结果只挑一个源下完，不会混拼。 两个仓库都是公开的，Gitee 的发行版列表匿名就能读，不需要填任何 token。 （只有在 Gitee 限流返回 403/429 时，才需要在设置里填一个只读 token 提高额度。） **开箱即有的默认行为**（不用去设置里找）： - 开机自动启动，常驻托盘；双击桌面图标直接进应用。 - 安装 APK 后自动创建**桌面 + 开始菜单**两份快捷方式，Windows 搜索能直接搜到应用名；老版本漏建的会在启动时自动补齐。 - 应用窗口是原生渲染（非投屏）：**全屏**铺满屏幕高度并居中、保持手机比例不变形；**窗口模式**保持竖屏，可自由拖动缩放，每个应用的尺寸单独记忆。随时按 `F11` 或右键托盘切换。 - 安装后自动授予应用申请的运行时权限，不会卡在系统授权框；应用闪退会自动重试、必要时重置应用数据后再拉起。 - **网络直接用主机的网络**：安卓侧走 QEMU 用户态 NAT，出口复用主机的物理网卡，**不会在 Windows 上创建任何虚拟网卡 / 虚拟交换机**（不需要装驱动、也不多一个网络适配器）。不需要联网下载、不需要改任何网络设置。 ## 设置页：分好类，还能搜 设置项越来越多，所以从 0.6.0 起设置页按用途分成八类，左侧一列导航： | 分类 | 装了什么 | |---|---| |

# ub-mode

`ub-mode` is an agent skill that enforces disciplined software engineering principles when writing or changing code. It is loosely based on portions of [@poteto](https://github.com/poteto)'s rules (`poteto-mode` / `pstack`), reduced and paired with deterministic quality-gate tools:

1. **First Make it Work** — Laziness Protocol, Foundational Thinking, TDD, Redesign From First Principles, Attack the Premise, Subtract Before You Add, Outcome-Oriented Execution, Build the Lever, and Architecture (Model the Domain, Boundary Discipline, Type System Discipline, Make Operations Idempotent, Separate Before Serializing Shared State).
2. **Then Make it Right** — Fix Root Causes, Sequence Work into Verifiable Units, Test Behavior (Not Implementation), [Crapper](https://github.com/unclebob/crapper) (`CRAP < 10`), [Dryer](https://github.com/unclebob/dryer) (duplication `< 0.8`), [Mutator](https://github.com/unclebob/mutator) (cover the uncovered, kill the survivors, delete dead code), and Refactoring.
3. **Practice** — Keep a Log, Guard the Context Window, Worktree Cleanup, and Commit and Push in small ordered commits.

## Companion Tool Repositories

`ub-mode` relies on deterministic quality-gate tools to enforce structure, complexity, duplication, and test thoroughness:

- [unclebob/crapper](https://github.com/unclebob/crapper) — Computes cyclomatic complexity, test coverage, and CRAP score per function so every function stays under the CRAP threshold (`< 10`).
- [unclebob/dryer](https://github.com/unclebob/dryer) — Detects structural code duplication so duplicate blocks (`>= 0.8` similarity) are eliminated.
- [unclebob/mutator](https://github.com/unclebob/mutator) — Runs mutation testing to expose uncovered code and surviving mutants that tests fail to catch.
- [unclebob/uml-viewer](https://github.com/unclebob/uml-viewer) — Visualizes components, coverage, CRAP, mutation scores, and dependency directions.

## Installation

Copy `SKILL.md` into your agent's skills directory as `ub-mode/SKILL.md` (for example `~/.grok/skills/ub-mode/SKILL.md`, `~/.claude/skills/ub-mode/SKILL.md`, or `~/.cursor/skills/ub-mode/SKILL.md`), then invoke `/ub-mode`.

# TotK Recomp

**TotK Recomp** is a static recompilation of *The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom* (Nintendo Switch, 2023) into a native x86-64 application for Windows and Linux ([docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **No game files are included.** You need your own legally obtained copy of *Tears of the Kingdom*, dumped from your own console: the base game and the 1.1.0, 1.2.1 or 1.4.3 update. Instructions for obtaining those files will not be provided.
>
> The game is built from your files on your machine, so the result contains the game. It is for your own use. Do not share it.

## Status

Early development. The game is playable on Windows and Linux; visual bugs and crashes are still expected.

Report problems as issues, following [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Features

- Native code, not emulation
- Game updates 1.1.0, 1.2.1 and 1.4.3; 1.2.1 and 1.4.3 saves carry over between them
- Takes NSP and XCI game files, and compressed NSZ and XCZ as they are: the setup unpacks them itself
- 60 fps by default; up to 144 fps or the monitor's refresh rate (experimental)
- Custom resolutions (1080p, 2k...), supersampling and AMD FSR 1 upscaling
- NVIDIA DLSS / DLAA on RTX GPUs: the setup downloads `nvngx_dlss.dll` from NVIDIA's DLSS SDK repository
  (github.com/NVIDIA/DLSS, NVIDIA RTX SDK license) when it finds an RTX GPU; untick it in the setup to skip it
- HDR10 output with peak, game and HUD brightness settings
- 16:10 (Steam Deck, handhelds), 3:2 (Surface, Framework), 21:9 and 32:9 (ultrawide) game resolutions, with the camera and the interface in that shape
- Anisotropic texture filtering up to 16x, for sharp ground into the distance
- In-game settings menu (F1) and performance overlay (F10)
- Play time across runs on the Game tab of the settings menu, kept in `playtime.txt` next to the saves
- Discord Rich Presence ("Playing TotK Recomp" with the play time), off by default, own application id supported
- Setup and in-game menu in English, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese and Simplified Chinese
- Keyboard, mouse and gamepad with remapping, rumble and gyro
- Stereo or 5.1 surround sound output
- Xbox button prompts: LB, RB, LT, RT, Menu and View, and A, B, X and Y as labelled on the button to press, with either button layout
- Shaders prepared at install instead of during play
- Mods made for emulators: unpack a mod into the `mods` folder next to `totk.exe`; switch and order them in the menu. RomFS
  mods, TKMM's merged output and ExeFS code patches (`.ips`, `.pchtxt`) work; the game rebuilds itself for code patches
  ([docs/mods.md](docs/mods.md)). HD texture packs work: the port grows the texture heap a pack asks for by itself. Tested
  with the HDPacks.com 4K Texture Pack v1.0 on 1.4.3 and 1.2.1; other packs come with no guarantee
- Atmosphère cheats: put a cheat file into a mod and switch its cheats in the menu ([docs/cheats.md](docs/cheats.md))

## Planned

- VRR

## Installing

### Windows

Requirements: Windows 10 or later, an x86-64 CPU with SSE4.2 (AVX2/FMA machines get a faster build), a GPU with Vulkan 1.3 and `VK_EXT_external_memory_host`, about 36 GiB free during setup (20 GiB after).

1. Download `TotK-Setup-<version>-windows.zip` from [Releases](../../releases/latest) and unpack it.
2. Start `TotK-Setup.exe`. If SmartScreen warns about an unsigned app, choose *More info*, then *Run anyway*.
3. Pick your game files, the language and an install folder, and press *Start*. The setup builds the game once. With
   an NVIDIA RTX GPU it also downloads NVIDIA DLSS, unless you untick *Download NVIDIA DLSS*; turn DLSS on in the
   menu (F1).
4. Play `totk.exe` from the install folder.

### Linux

Requirements: as on Windows, plus Linux 6.7 or later and glibc 2.34 or later (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Fedora 35, SteamOS 3).

1. Download `TotK-Setup-x86_64.AppImage` from [Releases](../../releases/latest), or build it ([docs/installer.md](docs/installer.md), "Linux release").
2. Make it executable (`chmod +x TotK-Setup-x86_64.AppImage`) and start it. On a Steam Deck, do this in Desktop Mode.
3. Pick your game files, the language and an install folder, and press *Start*.
4. Play `totk` from the install folder.

To update, run a newer setup on the same folder; saves and settings are kept. Settings are in the in-game menu and in `totk.ini` ([totk.ini.example](totk.ini.example) lists every key). Controls: [docs/controls.md](docs/controls.md).

## Credits

TotK Recomp builds on the projects below. What was taken from each, with its license, is listed in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

- [LAS Recomp](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp)

- [d2r-mobile](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile) and [nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative)
- [SavageWindRecomp](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp)
- [Ryujinx](https://github.com/Ryujinx/Ryujinx)
- [deko3d](https://github.com/devkitPro/

# Rune A native GPU-rendered Rust UI framework for macOS, Windows, Linux and the web, with its own renderer, text, layout and springs. Every app can run headless, so an agent can render to PNG, dump the element tree and drive it with scripted input.

```rust fn view(s: &State, _: &mut Cx) -> El { let t = tok::theme(true); let label = text(if s.on { "Lights on" } else { "Lights off" }) .font(type_::TITLE).color(t.text); let knob = el().key("knob").size(18.0, 18.0).radius(9.0).fill(t.knob) .absolute(if s.on { 18.0 } else { 2.0 }, 2.0); let switch = el().key("switch").role("switch").label("Lights").checked(s.on) .focusable(true).size(38.0, 22.0).radius(11.0) .fill(if s.on { tok::accent(0, true) } else { t.control_off }) .motion(motion::SNAPPY) .on_press(|s: &mut State| s.on = !s.on) .child(knob); col().w_full().h_full().center().gap(16.0).fill(t.bg).child(label).child(switch) } ``` ## Use it with your agent Give your coding agent this repo. Have it start from [`examples/hello`](examples/hello) and [`crates/rune/README.md`](crates/rune/README.md), then check its own work headlessly by rendering PNGs and inspecting the element tree. > Build me a with Rune (github.com/anomalyco/rune). Start from examples/hello and check your work headlessly. ## Add it ```toml rune = { git = "https://github.com/anomalyco/rune", rev = "" } ``` Rune is pre-release. Pin a rev of `dev`; `dev` is never rewritten. On Windows, the MSVC toolchain (`x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`, rustup's default) needs only the Visual Studio C++ build tools rustup asks for. The GNU toolchain (`x86_64-pc-windows-gnu`) also needs MinGW-w64's binutils on `PATH`: `windows-link` (under `parking_lot`, `libloading`, `windows-core` and `windows-sys`, so under every Windows UI crate) imports with `raw-dylib`, rustc makes those import libraries with `dlltool` on GNU targets, and the `dlltool` in rustup's `rust-mingw` can't run without an `as` it doesn't ship ([rust-lang/rust#140704](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/140704)). Without binutils the build stops at `windows-result` with `error calling dlltool 'dlltool.exe': program not found`. Install [MSYS2](https://www.msys2.org), run `pacman -S mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-binutils`, and put `C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin` on `PATH` (or build with `RUSTFLAGS=-Cdlltool=C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin\dlltool.exe`). [Docs](crates/rune/README.md) · [Components](crates/rune-kit/README.md) · [Examples](examples) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) ## Contributing We don't take pull requests. Have your agent [open an issue](https://github.com/anomalyco/rune/issues) describing the bug or idea, and our agents usually turn it around fast. MIT, © Anomaly.

# AI 角色参考与合成工作台 · 中文版（3合1）

> **姿势库（1,439 张素体白模 + 1,439 张深度图 Depth） + 服装库（3,224 套：ギア写实 1,407 + Shisei 中国历代 57 套/227 视角 + ギア动漫 1,320 + CharaDB 二次元 440） + 人像库（1,499 位） = 6,162 条全中文参考数据 / 12,022 张本地高清图，另有 1,760 张来源站点参考图**，集成 **5 大 AI 图像协议直连工作台** 与 **原生 ComfyUI 自定义节点插件（`custom_nodes`）**。

![画廊总览预览](docs/preview.jpg)

**在线演示：** <https://ai-pose-gallery.anhao.app/>

**原有图库作者：** ギア（@giaaibusi）；二次元服装作者：たき AI（[@taki_auto](https://x.com/taki_auto) · [CharaDB](https://charadb-2fi.pages.dev/)）。
**中文版维护：** Anhao · [X @anhao_ai](https://x.com/anhao_ai)
**GitHub：** <https://github.com/anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh>

> ⚠️ **免责声明（必读）**：
> 1. **学习与创作限定**：本项目及配套插件/工作流**仅供个人学习、人体动态研究、合法艺术创作与技术交流使用**，严禁用于任何违反法律法规、生成违法违规/淫秽色情内容或侵害他人合法权益（如未经授权的真人肖像换脸）的用途。

> 3. **来源与版权声明**：原有姿势、现实服装、人像参考图源自原作者 **ギア（@giaaibusi）** 公开站点；440 套二次元服装源自 **たき AI（@taki_auto）** 的 [CharaDB](https://charadb-2fi.pages.dev/)（详见其 [LICENSE](https://github.com/taki-ttt/charadb/blob/main/LICENSE)），版权归各自原作者所有；本仓库仅为中文翻译整理与工程学习存档，禁止将图库图片打包倒卖。使用者因违规使用产生的一切法律责任由使用者本人独立承担。

---

## 这是什么

原站是ギア（@giaaibusi）发布的三大 AI 绘画参考图库（姿势、服装、人像），元数据全部为日文，且分散在三个独立站点。本仓库（v2.0）完成了**三站合一、全量中文化、AI 角色合成工作台与 ComfyUI 原生插件升级**：

1. **三库四站全量本地镜像（11,568 张图）** —— 完整收录姿势库（素体白模 2,878 张 + 深度图 Depth 2,878 张 WebP）、服装库（2,814 张 WebP）、人像库（2,998 张，全尺寸 `1600×2000` 高清 WebP）的全部缩略图与高清原图，支持纯离线浏览与静态托管。
2. **原有图库全中文元数据** —— 动作体系、姿势分类、服装款式、穿搭标签、人像分区、发长与 51 种细分发型全部译为地道中文，自动组装的生图提示词纯净无日文干扰。
3. **三合一 AI 角色合成工作台（Web Studio）** —— 基于 **React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 + TypeScript 7 + shadcn/ui + TanStack Router** 构建的响应式多页面应用（兼容 PC / 平板 / 手机）：
   - 从三大图库任意挑选 **人像 + 服装 + 姿势（支持素体白模 / 深度图一键切换）** 组合配方，或一键随机捏人；
   - 支持拖拽、剪贴板粘贴（`Cmd+V` / `Ctrl+V`）或 URL 添加多张自定义附加参考图；
   - 内置 **5 大 AI 图像协议直连**（Google Gemini、OpenAI GPT Image、阿里云百炼 Qwen、字节火山方舟 Doubao、**本地 ComfyUI**），生成记录通过 **IndexedDB** 本地持久化保存。
4. **原生 ComfyUI 自定义节点插件（`custom_nodes`）** —— 本仓库同时是一个即插即用的 ComfyUI 插件！直接 `git clone` 到 `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/` 即可在 ComfyUI 画布内使用 **姿势 / 服装 / 人像 / 三合一角色配方** 4 个自定义节点（姿势与配方节点内置 `use_depth` 深度图切换，可直接接入 ControlNet Depth）与内置的 **6,162 条中文可视化弹窗选图器**。

---

## 核心功能

### 1. 三大参考图库（姿势 / 服装 / 人像）
- **姿势参考库（`/poses`）**：4 大体系（全身单人・标准系 / 全身单人・性感系 / 上半身单人 / 双人缠绵）、26 个动作分类、288 组姿势、5 种视角（正面 / 斜前 / 侧面 / 背面 / 俯视），支持**按姿势分组 / 逐张浏览**双模式、卡片内多角度切换，以及 **`[ 素体白模 | 深度图 (Depth) ]` 一键切换预览与下载**。
- **服装参考库（`/costumes`）**：8 大穿搭分类（春季 / 夏季 / 秋季 / 冬季 / 内衣・睡衣 / 性感穿搭 / 泳装・度假 / 派对・礼服）、86 个中文细节标签与英文 Prompt 关键词。
- **人像参考库（`/portraits`）**：2 大分区（正脸参考 893 / 造型氛围 606）、4 种发长（短发 / 中发 / 中长发 / 长发）、51 种细分发型，支持**精选题集**与**热门榜单**一键筛选。
- **统一交互体验**：中文关键词实时检索、灯箱高清原图预览与下载、一键「加入合成配方」。

### 2. AI 角色合成台（`/studio`）
- **3+N 参考图组合**：3 个核心槽位（人像 / 服装 / 姿势，姿势槽位内置 `[ 白模 | 深度 ]` 实时切换）+ 任意张自定义附加参考图（点击上传、拖拽文件、剪贴板粘贴、填写图片 URL）。
- **参考拼图预览与导出**：弹窗查看三合一高清参考拼图（`1800×1200` Canvas 实时合成），支持一键下载拼图 PNG。
- **12 种画风预设 & 纯中文结构化提示词**：内置「无预设（跟随参考图）」、写实人像写真、日韩杂志画报、复古胶片写真、2.5D 游戏原画立绘、日系二次元插画、新海诚感动画电影、日式黑白漫画网点、3D 次世代角色渲染、3D 潮玩手办质感、赛博朋克霓虹、角色设定集立绘（纯白底）共 12 种画风，根据已选素材自动组装提示词。
- **5 大 AI 图像协议与高级参数**：
  - **Google Gemini**：`gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview`、`gemini-3-pro-image-preview`、`gemini-2.5-flash-image`（支持宽高比 `aspectRatio`、分辨率 `1K/2K/4K`）
  - **OpenAI GPT Image**：`gpt-image-2.5`、`gpt-image-2`、`gpt-image-1.5`、`gpt-image-1`（支持 `/v1/images/edits` JSON URL 直传 / Multipart 上传、尺寸、质量、背景透明度）
  - **阿里云百炼 Qwen**：`qwen-image-3.0-pro`、`qwen-image-2.1-pro`、`qwen-image-2.0-pro`、`qwen-image-edit-plus`（支持 `multimodal-generation` 多图参考输入、智能改写 `prompt_extend`、水印开关）
  - **字节火山方舟 Doubao**：`doubao-seedream-5-0`、`doubao-seedream-4-5-251128`、`doubao-seedream-4-0-250828`、`doubao-seededit-3-0-i2i-250628`（支持多图融合 `image: [...]`、2K/4K 分辨率）
  - **本地 ComfyUI 工作流引擎**：支持自动将三合一拼图及单张人像/服装/姿势图上传至本地 ComfyUI（`/upload/image`），注入自定义 API 工作流占位符或自动识别节点提交 `/prompt` 队列并轮询取回成品图；支持导入/导出通用 `.api.json` 工作流模板。
- **跨页面后台生图 & IndexedDB 历史记录**：切换页面不会中断正在进行的生图请求；生成结果自动存入浏览器 IndexedDB（避免 `localStorage` 容量限制），支持复用提示词与原图下载。

> 本地 ComfyUI 三图合成（Qwen Image Edit 2509）的模型清单、工作流说明和本地运行方法见 [docs/comfyui-local.md](docs/comfyui-local.md)。

> 导入 API 后的动态高级参数、设定集参考上传与可选显示声明见 [ComfyUI 工作流高级参数](docs/comfyui-workflow-parameters.md)。

> WebSocket 实时进度、HTTP 保底与刷新恢复见 [ComfyUI 任务连接与恢复](docs/comfyui-task-tracking.md)。

### 3. ComfyUI 原生自定义节点插件（`comfyui_plugin/`）
将本仓库克隆到 `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ai-pose-gallery-zh` 后，ComfyUI 画布右键菜单 **「AI角色三合一参考图集」** 下自动提供 4 个节点：
- **AI 姿势参考图 (`PoseGalleryNode`)**：输出 `姿势图 (IMAGE)`、`图片ID`、`姿势提示词`（支持 `use_depth` 开关一键切换输出素体白模或深度图）
- **AI 服装参考图 (`CostumeGalleryNode`)**：输出 `服装图 (IMAGE)`、`图片ID`、`中文服装描述`、`英文服装Prompt`
- **AI 人像参考图 (`PortraitGalleryNode`)**：输出 `人像图 (IMAGE)`、`图片ID`、`人像发型描述`
- **AI 角色三合一合成配方 (`CharacterRecipeNode`)**：单节点同时输出 `人像图`、`服装图`、`姿势图（支持 use_depth 深度图切换）`、`三合一拼图` 以及自动组装的

Claude Cage

**把 Claude 大小姐关起来，为了更好地保护我们的相遇** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage?include_prereleases)](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage/releases) [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) **[项目主页](https://claude-cage.com/) · [下载应用](https://claude-cage.com/#download) · [插件市场](https://claude-cage.com/plugins/) · [使用文档](https://claude-cage.com/docs/) · [常见问题](https://claude-cage.com/docs/troubleshooting/)** [简体中文](README.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) · [Русский](README.ru.md) · [العربية](README.ar.md) · [فارسی](README.fa.md) · [한국어](README.ko.md) · [Español](README.es.md) · [မြန်မာဘာသာ](README.my.md) · [Беларуская](README.be.md) · [پښتو](README.ps.md) · [دری](README.prs.md) · [አማርኛ](README.am.md) · [Soomaali](README.so.md) · [ትግርኛ](README.ti.md) · [Français](README.fr.md)
## 设计理念 1. **Claude 本身是安全的，但它的运行外壳（harness）及相关程序不是**——包括 Claude Code、Claude Desktop，以及浏览器里接触到的邮件、网页与环境信号。 2. **想要在保证安全的前提下使用 Claude 的能力，通常有两条路线：反向代理，或者远程控制**——要么把 Claude 从远端服务器拉出来直接运行在主机上，要么把 Claude 部署在受控环境里，由它远程操作主机。我们认为后者更安全，也更合规。 3. **因此，Cage 的核心思想是：为 Claude 及相关程序打造一个轻量化的本地隔离环境，再通过标准 MCP 插件，让 Claude 安全、受控地使用本机能力**——每一次越出环境的调用都有明确的权限边界与用户确认，比直接暴露 SSH 更安全。 这样一来，Cage 同时实现了三个目标： - **把危险的部分关起来，把有用的能力放出来。** Claude 大小姐安心待在 Cage 里，坐在她的小螃蟹上，只需把手伸出来处理外面的工作——不必在 Cage 里重新搭一整间办公室。 - **通过插件市场，与开源社区解耦协作。** 我们开放了[插件市场（cage-plugins）](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/cage-plugins)：**插件 = MCP + 扩展**，分别对应「给 Claude 的能力」与「Cage 工作台的定制化」。开源社区可以在插件市场持续贡献工具、桌面控制与工作流扩展，而不必挤进 Cage 主仓库的 Issue 列表；Cage 核心维护团队也能更聚焦于隔离环境、网络与工作台本身的打磨。 - **合规、安全、轻量化、本地、低成本，一键安装、一键配置、开箱即用。** 我们不再需要维护复杂臃肿的多系统客机，不再担心 Claude 的能力被困在孤岛里，也无需承担高昂的云端成本或数据安全隐患——在自己电脑上就能优雅地实现这一切。 ## 受够了 Anthropic 作为一个只是想和 Claude 对话与合作的正常用户，受够了折腾各种 VPS，指纹浏览器，环境检测，面对封号的担惊受怕和财产损失。我们提出 **Claude Cage** 项目：**一个开箱即用的桌面程序，配置好自己的网络代理，集中管理轻量化隔离环境、时区语言、环境检查与插件能力。** Claude Cage 在一个小型的 Debian 13 环境里运行官方 Claude Code 和 Claude Desktop，macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上都是同一个环境。终端、浏览器、编辑器、官方 Claude Desktop 与插件市场汇集在同一个工作台，项目按需共享，网络独立管理；既可以通过插件安全调用本机能力，也可以连接自己的服务器，或用手机接续电脑上的任务。支持以下几个重点功能： - 和主机隔离的网络设置，Cage 自己接管和代理内部的所有网络流量 - 和主机隔离的指纹设置，包括时区、语言等，支持自动与代理 IP 同步 - 针对 Claude 使用过程中的全链路适配（浏览器登录，授权，claude code 进程） - 内置网络与隔离检查，关键检查失败或证据不完整时暂停外网；社区和第三方检测提供补充参考 **使用 Cage 的环境检测结果：** | 网络与隔离检查 | 浏览器环境检测（社区参考） | | :---: | :---: | | | | [FuckClaude](https://fuck-claude.vercel.app/) · [LinXiaoTao / GitHub](https://github.com/LinXiaoTao/FuckClaude) **Cage 运行主界面：** ![Cage](www/public/workbench-2026-11.jpg) ## 你可以用它做什么 - **在一个窗口里完成工作。** 用终端运行 Claude Code，用编辑器查看改动，用 Cage 浏览器预览服务和完成登录。 - **通过插件市场解锁全部能力。** 内置开放的[插件市场（cage-plugins）](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/cage-plugins)，插件 = MCP + 扩展：既能让环境里的 Claude 通过标准 MCP 安全、受控地使用本机能力（如桌面键鼠控制、Office 文档、Blender、命令行工具等），也能通过沙箱页面定制 Cage 工作台。主机插件默认受权限声明与弹窗确认保护。 [插件与插件市场](docs/guide/plugins.md) · [开发规范](docs/plugins.md) - **三个平台，同一个轻量化环境。** macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上的 Cage 都运行同一个轻量化 Debian 13 环境，无需维护复杂的多系统客机，工具与操作方式一致。 [Debian 环境](docs/guide/guest-systems.md) - **控制共享范围。** 只共享默认工作区和明确打开的项目文件夹；主机的 Claude 登录、浏览器配置和 SSH 密钥不会自动导入。 - **看清网络状态。** 内置代理管理支持导入订阅、选择节点和检查出口。关键检查未通过时，环境保持离线；代理不可用时没有直连回退。 - **下次继续使用。** 工具、文件和登录状态保存在虚拟磁盘里，关闭窗口可以保留后台任务。 - **管理多个 Claude Code 订阅。** 查看额度、为新会话分配账号，并在明确授权后切换账号接续历史。 [Claude Code](docs/guide/accounts.md) - **从手机继续处理任务。** Android / iPhone 配对电脑，接续 Claude Code 对话与工具审批，或操作远程浏览器和 Claude Desktop。 [手机连接](docs/guide/mobile.md) - **把环境放到自己的服务器。** 通过 SSH 部署或连接 Linux VPS，工具、任务和数据留在服务器，无需 KVM。 [云端部署与 SSH](docs/guide/cloud.md) - **通过私网连接设备。** 在 Cage 内登录 Tailscale，查看网络中的设备，使用 SSH、Web 与其他 TCP 服务。 [Tailscale 私网](docs/guide/tailscale.md) 浏览器收藏、无痕会话、Cookie、扩展、密码保险箱，以及外观、资源、存储和工具更新，见[完整使用文档](https://claude-cage.com/docs/)。 ## 快速开始 把这句话发给你的 agent（codex，dsh，workbuddy，反正不会是 claude code😁） ```markdown 帮我拉取 https://
